task.title: Ignore by extension
task.shortdesc: Exclude all files with a specific extension (for example, .temp) from Git version control.

context.p: To do so, go to the view and follow these steps:

step.cmd: On , select a file with the extension you want to ignore (for example, file.temp).
Right-click the file to open the contextual menu.

result.p: The extension is added to the end of the project's .gitignore.
